s.how: Toss 500g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli and lime zest. Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side. Mix fish sauce, lime juice and a spoon of sugar for a dipping sauce. Serve from the boat.

Soak rice paper sheets one at a time and fill with cooked prawns, soaked vermicelli, mint, coriander and lettuce. Roll tightly. Warm 3 tbsp peanut butter with 2 tbsp hoisin and a splash of water for a thick dipping sauce.

m.note: the soup Benja makes with something from every land
m.how: Simmer 200g jasmine rice in 2L chicken stock with bruised lemongrass and sliced ginger for an hour, stirring often, until creamy. Add 400g green prawns and sliced bamboo shoots for the last 5 minutes. Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.

w.how: Soak 300g glutinous rice overnight, then steam for 25 minutes. Warm 400ml coconut milk with 80g sugar and a pinch of salt, pour most over the hot rice and rest 20 minutes. Serve with sliced mango, the rest of the coconut and sesame.

d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes and stir in 3 tbsp sugar. Cool completely. Pour over ice in tall glasses and top each with a spoon of condensed milk so it swirls down like a dragon.
